Round 7 complete. The candidate node is committed and evaluated.

## What I did

**Stage 1 — Lineage analysis.** The lineage is a linear chain N0→N7 (baseline 0.4311 → N7 0.5544). I selected **N7 (`3b572cc`, 0.5544)** as parent: it is the strongest recent node and it left its own lever unbuilt — its note proposed that "the title drop... can be done by the harness itself", and I verified from its own trace that its model-driven check rewrote **none** of the entries its list's own writing settles (`销售假冒注册商标的商品罪`, `破坏电力设备罪`, `持有伪造的发票罪` all stand as written).

**Stage 2 — Mechanism.** The harness now performs that reading itself instead of asking for it: `listed_endings` derives what a written name of the memory's own list can end with, `written_the_lists_way` drops trailing characters the list never ends a name with (stopping when the name on hand is one the list writes), `written_message` applies it to the reply's `final_answer` alone, and `agent.py` gates it on `memory_joiner()` so single-string-answer memories (USPTO, Symptom2Disease) are untouched and no model call is added. The answer key itself is byte-identical to the parent's.

**Offline audit (no model calls), over all 8 lineage runs (2059 samples):** 121 answers rewritten, 40 flips wrong→right, **0** right→wrong, **0** of 1187 correct answers touched. Its residual risk is measured and reported: 3–4 score-equivalent writings of the Val golds would be changed, and two guards that would prevent that were priced (they cost 15 and 12 of the 40 flips) and left out.

## Result

`{"USPTO": 0.2167, "Symptom2Disease": 0.89, "LawBench": 0.52, "average": 0.5422}` vs the parent's 0.5544 — a tie-to-slightly-below inside the lineage's ~0.03 run-to-run floor.

The difference is not the mechanism: **6 LawBench samples were lost to the provider's content filter** (the parent lost 1), and failed samples count as wrong, so 52/94 answered became 0.52. On the conversations that were answered, this node scores 52/94 — **exactly what the parent's own reading of those same conversations would have scored** (reconstructed and scored). The mechanism rewrote 8 answers, flipped none and broke none, because the conversation answered the three questions it was built for correctly by itself this time. USPTO (−1 sample) and Symptom2Disease (+2) are the draws those tasks retake at across nodes with byte-identical memory.

Commit `856cc92` on branch `list-endings-writing` (tree `c1139da1…` = the evaluated tree), notes attached under `refs/notes/evolution`, run evidence in `runs/c1139da1a767e345bd6a3e68ba1c66a4c6337c3f/`. The note also records the families this round closed offline (co-occurrence and nearest-precedent candidate signals at 1–5% precision, retrieval-budget coverage worth 1 question, guard widening with 0 discarded fixes, weak within-run self-consistency) and points the next lever at the provider refusals — 19 LawBench samples across the lineage's eight runs, every one a guaranteed wrong answer.
